'''Castaan Staad Armor''' was a [[Blast vest/Legends|blast vest]] produced specifically for [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] warrior caste members by [[Castaan Armory]]. The vest closed on one side and allowed for greater flexibility at the expense of protection. While generally made to customer specifics, the [[Armor/Legends|armor]] was also available as a "generic" model for off-world sales.
